How to use this calculator

  1. Enter password length, lowercase letters, uppercase letters and the remaining inputs.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How password generator is calculated

Generate a password from user-selected length and character groups using a cryptographically secure random source. Each enabled group is guaranteed to appear at least once, and rejection sampling avoids modulo bias. Keep generated secrets private and store them in a password manager. A 20-character password using all four groups has a much larger search space than a short dictionary word. The calculation validates each input and keeps its stated units explicit. It uses the browser or runtime cryptographic random generator; the module does not transmit the output. This is an estimate for the stated assumptions; confirm measurements and any applicable professional or local standards before relying on it.

Password Generator is calculated from the supplied measurement fields using the units shown.

Frequently asked questions

Is generation secure offline?

It uses the browser or runtime cryptographic random generator; the module does not transmit the output.

Can I omit confusing characters?

Yes. Excluding look-alike characters is useful for manual transcription but slightly reduces the available alphabet.
